contract:
Contract ProcessSaleService::makeCashPayment(amount: Real): Boolean {
	definition:
		cs: Sale = self.CurrentSale,
		st: Store = self.CurrentStore
	precondition:
		cs<>null and
		st<>null and
		Sale.allInstances()->includes(cs) and
		Store.allInstances()->includes(st) and
		cs.IsComplete = false and
		cs.IsReadytoPay = true and
		amount>=cs.Amount
	postcondition:
		result = true and
		cs.Belongedstore = st and
		cs.Time = Now and
		cs.IsComplete = true and
		CashPayment.allInstances()->exists(p: CashPayment|p.oclIsNew() and
		p.AmountTendered = amount and
		p.Balance = amount-cs.Amount and
		p.BelongedSale = cs and
		cs.AssoicatedPayment = p and
		Payment.allInstances()->includes(p))
}
